name: Billie's Wheelie
description:
🧀🧀 Billie’s Wheelie 🧀🧀

Get ready for high-speed hamster chaos! 🐹💨
In this fast-paced adventure racing platformer, you take control of Billie, an adorable hamster on a mission to roll, race, and zoom through wild, dynamic tracks. Jump, dodge, and boost your way to victory, all while collecting cheese 🧀 and outplaying your opponents!

🏁 ONLINE FAST-PACED RACING ACTION! 🏁

Speed through intense tracks designed to test your reflexes! With fluid movement, tricky obstacles, and crazy jumps! with 2 to 8 players online!
Master precise controls to drift, dodge, and boost your way past competitors!

🎨 CUSTOMIZE YOUR HAMSTER! 🐹

Choose your adorable hamster look, roll in a custom ball, and leave a trail mark as you speed through the tracks. and Celebrate your victories in style with hilarious victory emotes

🌍 EXPLORE DYNAMIC TRACKS! 🏁

Race through stunning environments, from Candy World to Space tracks, each packed with exciting surprises!

⚡ SUN FLOWER SUPER POWER-UPS 🎢

Strategize your way to victory with well-timed boosts, shields, and sneaky tricks to outplay the competition, By Unleashing crazy power-ups to boost past rivals, slow down opponents, and create total chaos on the track!

🛣️ MORE CONTENT ON THE WAY! 📌

Career Mode, Challenges & MORE updates!
New levels, features, and surprises are coming! The race never stops in Billie’s Wheelie!

🎉 ROLL, RACE & CHEEEEEEEESE YOUR WAY TO VICTORY! 🎉

🐹💨 Are you ready for a crazy hamster racing adventure? Jump in now and experience the thrill of speed and cheese-fueled fun! 🧀🏆
